items.title: Several key Red Raiders land on initial availability report ahead of TCU
items.summary: Texas Tech and TCU released their initial availability reports Monday night ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving Day matchup in Lubbock. Here is who is on the list.

items.title: Texas Tech prepares for short week against TCU as defense looks to finish strong
items.summary: Texas Tech defensive coordinator Shiel Wood discusses preparing for a short week against TCU, the defense's improvement late in the season, and the leadership of Ben Roberts and Amier Boyd's play heading into Thursday night's matchup.

items.title: Mack Leftwich breaks down Thomas Castellanos' interceptions, TCU's defense and turning down UTEP
items.summary: Mack Leftwich discusses Thomas Castellanos' interceptions at Baylor, TCU's defense, Malcolm Simmons and why he turned down UTEP to stay at Texas Tech.

items.title: Joey McGuire details how Texas Tech will prepare for TCU on short week, reflects on Baylor victory
items.summary: Texas Tech head coach Joey McGuire offered a strong assessment of TCU's defense on Monday and explained how Texas Tech is preparing on a short week for Thursday's regular-season finale.

items.title: Tech eyes title game berth in Thanksgiving clash vs. TCU
items.summary: The Red Raiders host the Horned Frogs on Thanksgiving night with a Big 12 Championship berth on the line, looking to extend their 14-game home winning streak and return to Arlington for the second straight season

items.title: McGuire voices CFP confusion, where he expects Texas Tech to be ranked Tuesday
items.summary: Joey McGuire voiced his confusion for the College Football Playoff rankings and where he expects Texas Tech when the new rankings drop Tuesday.

items.title: AJ Holmes discusses Texas Tech's defensive dominance, and Red Raider support after Baylor win
items.summary: AJ Holmes reflects on Texas Tech's defensive dominance against Baylor, the Red Raiders' strong play in the trenches, incredible fan support and the team mentality driving their push toward another Big 12 Championship appearance.

items.title: Three Up, Three Down: Red Raiders take over Waco
items.summary: On Saturday afternoon, the Texas Tech Red Raiders defeated Baylor 20-10. What went right for the Red Raiders and what didn’t go so well in the win? We take a look with our weekly three up, three down.

items.title: Where did Texas Tech land in the latest national polls after its win at Baylor?
items.summary: Texas Tech made a move in the latest national polls after its win at Baylor. See where the Red Raiders landed in the AP Poll and Coaches Poll.

items.title: Highs and Lows: What PFF grades tell us about Texas Tech's win over Baylor
items.summary: Texas Tech moved one step closer to the Big 12 Championship with a 20-10 win over Baylor. Here's how PFF graded the Red Raiders.

items.title: Postgame Notes: Texas Tech at Baylor
items.summary: Texas Tech Football Postgame Notes: at Baylor

items.title: No. 12 Texas Tech collects 20-10 road win over Baylor
items.summary: Malcolm Simmons made another big play for No. 11 Texas Tech with his go-ahead 48-yard touchdown catch, and the defending Big 12 champion Red Raiders moved within one win of reaching another conference title game by beating Baylor 20-10 on Saturday.

items.title: The Brand: Episode Three - Fireworks
items.summary: Following its loss to Cincinnati, the Red Raiders' season on the line each and every week, hoping to get back to the Big 12 Championship. The Brand goes through Texas Tech's wins over Arizona, West Virginia and Oklahoma State, giving viewers an inside look into the preparations made by A.J. Holmes Jr.

items.title: Holmes named Outland Trophy semifinalist
items.summary: The Outland Trophy is presented annually to college football's most outstanding interior lineman; finalists will be announced Nov. 24

items.title: Castellanos, Williams named to Pony Express Award Elite 11
items.summary: The Pony Express Award winners will be announced in December

items.title: Red Raiders stay put at No. 12 in CFP rankings
items.summary: The next CFP rankings will be released Nov. 24 at 6:30 p.m. CT

items.title: What's Next With Joey McGuire Podcast: Episode 52
items.summary: In this week's episode, Joey McGuire and Robert Giovannetti recap Texas Tech's dominating win in Stillwater and the aftermath of a quiet Boone Pickens Stadium after a 52-27 rout. The episode also features McGuire's weekly CFP projection and how he is keeping the Red Raiders focused heading into a crucial two-game stretch.

items.title: Red Raiders in the NFL: Week 10
items.summary: Patrick Mahomes II and Chiefs lit up the scoreboard in Atlanta, putting up 35 points thanks to five passing touchdowns by the former Red Raider.

items.title: Harrington back on Lou Groza Award semifinalists list
items.summary: Texas Tech fifth-year senior kicker Stone Harrington was back on the semifinalist list Tuesday for the Lou Groza Award, recognizing the nation's top kicker. This is the second-consecutive season Harrington has been named among the 20 semifinalists.
